note: Margins are in accuracy points (percentage points), ARC minus reference, same items, greedy decoding. A group PASSES when the lower end of the 95% confidence interval of the paired difference is at or above -margin; it FAILS when the upper end is below -margin (ARC is worse by more than the margin with 95% confidence); otherwise it is INCONCLUSIVE (too few items to decide). A run below a group's certification size can only ever be a smoke result. See docs/quality/kimi-quality-harness.md.
